create-pdf-custom-title-page.title: Create PDF with Custom Title Page and Background
create-pdf-custom-title-page.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF, set document metadata, add a full‑page colored background using a Graph, and place centered title text with a custom font and color.

insert-image-into-pdf-absolute-coordinat.title: Insert Image into PDF at Absolute Coordinates
insert-image-into-pdf-absolute-coordinat.description: The example creates a PDF document, defines a rectangle with absolute coordinates, and inserts an in‑memory PNG image into the page at that location.

create-searchable-pdf-from-scanned-image.title: Create Searchable PDF from Scanned Images using OCR Overlay
create-searchable-pdf-from-scanned-image.description: Shows how to load a scanned‑image PDF, use Aspose.Pdf's Convert method to overlay invisible OCR text via a callback, and save the result as a searchable PDF.

add-indented-paragraph-with-line-spacing.title: Add Indented Paragraph with Line Spacing to PDF
add-indented-paragraph-with-line-spacing.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextParagraph with first‑line and subsequent line indentation, apply line spacing, and insert it onto a page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-multi-level-toc-to-pdf.title: Add Multi‑Level Table of Contents to PDF
add-multi-level-toc-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to enable auto‑tagging, detect headings, create a TOC element, insert a dedicated TOC page, and configure its appearance and outline integration using Aspose.Pdf.

customize-toc-formatting.title: Customize Table of Contents Formatting in PDF
customize-toc-formatting.description: Demonstrates how to set different tab leader types for TOC levels and disable page number display using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-page-from-pdf.title: Remove a Page from PDF and Renumber Remaining Pages
remove-page-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific page from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and automatically renumber the remaining pages before saving the result.

insert-blank-cover-page-into-pdf.title: Insert Blank Cover Page into PDF
insert-blank-cover-page-into-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, insert an empty page at the beginning as a cover sheet, and save the updated document.

replace-word-in-pdf.title: Replace Word in PDF While Preserving Formatting
replace-word-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to search for a specific word in a PDF and replace it with another word using Aspose.Pdf, while automatically keeping the original font, size, and color of the text.

extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.title: Extract Images from PDF and Save as PNG
extract-images-from-pdf-to-png.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's image resources, and save each image as a PNG file while preserving its original resolution.

add-digital-signature-to-pdf.title: Add Digital Signature Field and Sign PDF with Self‑Signed Certificate
add-digital-signature-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a signature field in a PDF, configure a PKCS#1 signature using a self‑signed PFX certificate, and save the signed document using Aspose.Pdf.

validate-pdf-a1a-compliance-report.title: Validate PDF for PDF/A-1A Compliance and Generate Report
validate-pdf-a1a-compliance-report.description: The example loads a PDF file, validates it against the PDF/A‑1A standard using Aspose.Pdf, and writes a detailed validation report to a text file.

validate-pdf-a1b-compliance.title: Validate PDF for PDF/A‑1B compliance and log results
validate-pdf-a1b-compliance.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, validate it against the PDF/A‑1B standard, and write a validation log file indicating any non‑conformant elements.

remove-metadata-javascript-embedded-file.title: Remove Metadata, JavaScript, and Embedded Files from a PDF
remove-metadata-javascript-embedded-file.description: Demonstrates how to clean a PDF by removing standard and hidden metadata, embedded attachments, and JavaScript actions using Aspose.Pdf, then saving the reduced‑size document.

set-pdf-expiration-date.title: Set PDF Expiration Date with JavaScript
set-pdf-expiration-date.description: Shows how to embed a JavaScript action in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so the document closes automatically after a specified expiration date.

flatten-pdf-form-fields.title: Flatten PDF Form Fields to Static Content
flatten-pdf-form-fields.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, flatten all interactive form fields into static page content, and save the resulting document.

check-pdf-incremental-updates.title: Check PDF for Incremental Updates
check-pdf-incremental-updates.description: Loads a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and determines whether the file contains incremental updates saved after its initial creation.

add-watermark-layer-merge-layers.title: Add Watermark Layer and Merge Layers in PDF
add-watermark-layer-merge-layers.description: Demonstrates how to create a watermark as an optional content group (layer), add it to each page of an existing PDF, and then merge all layers into a single layer using Aspose.Pdf.

add-accessibility-tags-to-pdf.title: Add Accessibility Tags to PDF (Headings, Paragraphs, Tables)
add-accessibility-tags-to-pdf.description: Loads an existing PDF, enables auto‑tagging, sets language and title metadata, and creates tagged heading, paragraph, and table elements with alternative text for screen readers before saving the tagged PDF.

attach-portfolio-pdf-set-description-met.title: Attach Portfolio PDF and Set Custom Description Metadata
attach-portfolio-pdf-set-description-met.description: Demonstrates how to embed a PDF portfolio file into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf and add custom description metadata (both XMP and document info).

update-pdf-author-title-metadata.title: Update PDF Author and Title Metadata
update-pdf-author-title-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to read existing PDF metadata, change the Author and Title fields, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-password-protection-to-pdf.title: Apply Password Protection and Permissions to a PDF
apply-password-protection-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, setting user and owner passwords, defining permissions, encrypting with AES‑256, and saving the protected document.

print-pdf-using-default-handler.title: Print PDF Document Using Default PDF Handler
print-pdf-using-default-handler.description: Shows how to verify a PDF file exists and is valid, then send it to the printer by launching the OS default PDF viewer with the "print" verb via Process.Start.

interrupt-resume-large-pdf-save.title: Interrupt and Resume Large PDF Save Operation
interrupt-resume-large-pdf-save.description: Demonstrates how to pause a long-running PDF save using Aspose.Pdf's interrupt monitor, release resources, and then resume the incremental save later.

generate-crash-report-pdf.title: Generate Crash Report PDF from Exception
generate-crash-report-pdf.description: Demonstrates capturing an exception, creating an HTML crash report with Aspose.Pdf, and converting that report into a PDF document.

embed-zugferd-xml-into-pdf.title: Embed ZUGFeRD XML into PDF and Verify Embedding
embed-zugferd-xml-into-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a ZUGFeRD invoice XML file into an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then verify that the XML is present in the embedded files collection.

add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf.title: Add JavaScript Open Action to PDF
add-javascript-open-action-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates embedding JavaScript in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf so an alert dialog appears when the document is opened.

combine-multiple-html-to-pdf.title: Combine Multiple HTML Strings into a Single PDF
combine-multiple-html-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load HTML strings into Aspose.Pdf Document objects with custom HtmlLoadOptions, merge the documents, and save the combined result as a PDF file.

add-styled-table-alternating-row-colors.title: Add Styled Table with Alternating Row Colors to PDF
add-styled-table-alternating-row-colors.description: Demonstrates creating a table with borders, header styling, and alternating row background colors, then inserting it into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf.title: Add Hyperlink Annotation to PDF
add-hyperlink-annotation-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a clickable hyperlink annotation that opens an external website in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-image-in-pdf-page.title: Replace Image in PDF Page
replace-image-in-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to replace an existing image on a PDF page with a new image while preserving its layout (position, size, rotation) using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-numbers-to-pdf-footer.title: Add Page Numbers to PDF Footer
add-page-numbers-to-pdf-footer.description: Demonstrates how to insert sequential page numbers into the footer of each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PageNumberStamp.

create-pdf-multiple-sections-different-p.title: Create PDF with Multiple Sections and Different Page Sizes
create-pdf-multiple-sections-different-p.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF containing several pages, each with its own page size and orientation (portrait, landscape, custom) using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.title: Merge PDFs and Preserve Bookmarks with Aspose.Pdf
merge-pdfs-with-bookmarks.description: Demonstrates how to combine two PDF files into one while copying all pages and preserving the bookmark hierarchy from both source documents using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-text-from-pdf-pages.title: Extract Text from Specific PDF Pages
extract-text-from-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extract text from a defined page range using TextAbsorber, and write the result to a plain text file.

add-company-logo-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Company Logo Header to PDF Pages
add-company-logo-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load an existing PDF, create an ImageStamp for a logo, position it as a top‑center header on each page, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-document-metadata.title: Set PDF Document Metadata (Creation/Modification Dates and Keywords)
set-pdf-document-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to load an existing PDF with Aspose.Pdf, update its creation and modification dates, add custom keywords, and save the updated file.

create-pdf-with-embedded-truetype-font.title: Create PDF with Embedded TrueType Font
create-pdf-with-embedded-truetype-font.description: Demonstrates how to embed a TrueType font into a PDF using Aspose.Pdf so the document renders consistently on any device.

apply-semi-transparent-image-watermark.title: Apply Semi-Transparent Image Watermark to PDF Pages
apply-semi-transparent-image-watermark.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent PNG image as a watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

create-clickable-table-of-contents.title: Create Clickable Table of Contents in PDF
create-clickable-table-of-contents.description: Shows how to generate a PDF with a table of contents where each entry is a clickable link that jumps to the corresponding section heading using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, delete all annotations, and save a clean version.

add-signature-field-to-pdf.title: Add Signature Field to PDF with Matching Appearance
add-signature-field-to-pdf.description: Shows how to insert a user signature form field into an existing PDF and configure its default appearance to align with the document's style using Aspose.Pdf.

encrypt-pdf-aes256-restrict-permissions.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Restrict Permissions
encrypt-pdf-aes256-restrict-permissions.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption, disable printing and copying by setting no permissions, and save the encrypted file.

create-pdf-portfolio.title: Create PDF Portfolio with Embedded Files
create-pdf-portfolio.description: Shows how to bundle several PDF documents into a single PDF portfolio by embedding each source file as a file specification using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-document-info-and-xmp-metadat.title: Add Custom Document Info and XMP Metadata to PDF
add-custom-document-info-and-xmp-metadat.description: Demonstrates how to add custom key/value pairs to a PDF's DocumentInfo dictionary and embed XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.

add-line-annotation-with-custom-color-th.title: Add Line Annotation with Custom Color and Thickness to PDF
add-line-annotation-with-custom-color-th.description: Demonstrates how to create a line annotation on a PDF page, set its color, and adjust its thickness using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-page-with-html.title: Replace PDF Page with HTML-Generated Page
replace-pdf-page-with-html.description: Demonstrates how to replace a specific page in an existing PDF with a new page created from HTML content using Aspose.Pdf's HTML-to-PDF conversion.

add-javascript-sum-calculation-to-pdf-fo.title: Calculate Sum of Two PDF Form Fields with JavaScript
add-javascript-sum-calculation-to-pdf-fo.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF with two numeric input fields and a read‑only sum field, then attaching JavaScript actions to automatically calculate and display the sum when either field changes.

generate-dynamic-pdf-table.title: Generate a Dynamic PDF Table from a DataTable
generate-dynamic-pdf-table.description: Demonstrates how to build a DataTable at runtime and import it into an Aspose.Pdf Table that automatically expands rows, then save the result as a PDF.

create-zugferd-compliant-pdf-invoice.title: Create ZUGFeRD-Compliant PDF Invoice with Embedded XML
create-zugferd-compliant-pdf-invoice.description: The example creates a simple PDF invoice, embeds ZUGFeRD XML data, converts the document to ZUGFeRD format, and saves the resulting PDF.

create-pdf-clickable-index.title: Create PDF with Clickable Table of Contents
create-pdf-clickable-index.description: Shows how to build a PDF that contains a Table of Contents page with entries linked to their respective section pages using Aspose.Pdf link annotations and GoTo actions.

add-background-template-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Background Template to All PDF Pages
add-background-template-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF and a single‑page background template, then stamp each page of the target document with the template as a background using Aspose.Pdf.

add-signature-image-stamp-to-last-page.title: Add Signature Image Stamp to Last PDF Page
add-signature-image-stamp-to-last-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create an ImageStamp from a signature image, position it on the last page, and save the updated document.

extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.title: Extract Embedded Files from PDF Portfolio
extract-embedded-files-from-pdf-portfoli.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF portfolio, enumerate its embedded files, and save each file to a specified output directory using Aspose.Pdf.

create-readonly-text-field-with-default-.title: Create Read‑Only Text Field with Default Value in PDF
create-readonly-text-field-with-default-.description: Demonstrates how to add a TextBoxField to a PDF, set its default text, and make it read‑only using Aspose.Pdf.

create-pdf-with-clickable-email-link.title: Create PDF with Clickable Email Link
create-pdf-with-clickable-email-link.description: Shows how to add a link annotation that opens the default mail client via a mailto URI in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-captions-below-images-in-pdf.title: Add Captions Below Images in PDF
add-captions-below-images-in-pdf.description: Shows how to iterate over image resources in a PDF and insert a styled caption paragraph beneath each image using Aspose.Pdf's text APIs.

create-pdf-toc-with-dot-leaders.title: Create PDF Table of Contents with Dot Leaders
create-pdf-toc-with-dot-leaders.description: Shows how to generate a PDF document that includes a table of contents with dot leaders between entry titles and page numbers using Aspose.Pdf's tagged content features.

add-popup-note-annotation.title: Add Pop‑up Note Annotation to PDF
add-popup-note-annotation.description: Shows how to create a TextAnnotation with a linked PopupAnnotation in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document.

create-pdf-header-with-current-date.title: Create PDF Header with Current Date Using JavaScript
create-pdf-header-with-current-date.description: Shows how to add a shared read‑only date field to the top of each PDF page and populate it with the current date via a JavaScript OnOpen action.

digitally-sign-pdf-with-timestamp.title: Digitally Sign PDF with Trusted Timestamp
digitally-sign-pdf-with-timestamp.description: Demonstrates how to add a PKCS#7 digital signature to a PDF and attach a timestamp from a trusted Time‑Stamp Authority using Aspose.Pdf.

create-5x7-inch-postcard-pdf.title: Create a 5x7 Inch Postcard PDF with Aspose.Pdf
create-5x7-inch-postcard-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with a custom 5x7‑inch page size and add a sample text fragment using Aspose.Pdf.

add-background-color-to-pdf-page.title: Add Background Color to PDF Page with Opacity
add-background-color-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to fill an entire PDF page with a semi‑transparent color by adding a rectangle shape to a Graph and inserting it into the page's paragraphs collection.

insert-pdf-page-into-another.title: Insert a PDF Page into Another PDF at a Specific Position
insert-pdf-page-into-another.description: Demonstrates loading two PDF documents, extracting a page from the source PDF, inserting it into a target PDF at a given position, and saving the result.

create-pdf-with-dropdown-list.title: Create PDF with Dropdown (ComboBox) Form Field
create-pdf-with-dropdown-list.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a ComboBox (dropdown) form field and populate it with items from an array using Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-count-footer-to-pdf.title: Add Page Count Footer to PDF Pages
add-page-count-footer-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a custom footer that shows "Page X of Y" on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, including creating a placeholder PDF if the source file is missing.

remove-javascript-from-pdf.title: Remove JavaScript from PDF
remove-javascript-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, clear document‑level, page‑level and link‑annotation JavaScript actions, and save the cleaned file.

create-pdf-with-merged-header-table.title: Create PDF with Merged Header Table
create-pdf-with-merged-header-table.description: Shows how to generate a PDF that contains a single merged‑header table followed by a multi‑column data table, applying borders, padding, and text styling with Aspose.Pdf.

add-link-annotation-open-pdf-attachment.title: Add Link Annotation to Open PDF Attachment
add-link-annotation-open-pdf-attachment.description: Shows how to create a link annotation on a PDF page that opens an external PDF attachment using Aspose.Pdf.

create-rotated-landscape-pdf-page.title: Create Rotated Landscape PDF Page
create-rotated-landscape-pdf-page.description: Shows how to rotate a PDF page 90° to achieve landscape orientation with Aspose.Pdf and add a text fragment for visual verification.

add-checked-checkbox-form-field.title: Add Checked Checkbox Form Field to PDF
add-checked-checkbox-form-field.description: Shows how to create a PDF document, add a checkbox form field, set its default state to checked, and save the file.

extract-pdf-outline-hierarchy.title: Extract and Print PDF Outline Hierarchy
extract-pdf-outline-hierarchy.description: Loads a PDF file, accesses its outline (bookmarks) and prints the hierarchical structure to the console.

create-pdf-table-with-rich-text.title: Create PDF Table with Rich Text Formatting
create-pdf-table-with-rich-text.description: Demonstrates how to build a PDF document containing a table where each cell can hold rich‑text formatting such as bold, italic, colored, underlined and multiple text segments using Aspose.Pdf.

add-diagonal-text-stamp-to-pdf.title: Add Diagonal Text Stamp Watermark to PDF
add-diagonal-text-stamp-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a TextStamp with a custom message, configure its appearance, apply it to every page, and save the stamped document.

insert-automatic-page-numbers-into-pdf.title: Insert Automatic Page Numbers into PDF
insert-automatic-page-numbers-into-pdf.description: Shows how to add a PageNumberStamp to every page of a PDF and reapply it after inserting a new page so the numbering updates automatically.

create-pdf-with-background-template.title: Create PDF with Background Template Page
create-pdf-with-background-template.description: Shows how to load a PDF page as a background template and apply it to multiple pages using PdfPageStamp in Aspose.Pdf.

add-visible-digital-signature-and-lock-p.title: Add Visible Digital Signature Field and Lock PDF
add-visible-digital-signature-and-lock-p.description: The example loads an existing PDF, creates a visible signature field on the first page, signs it with a PKCS#1 certificate, makes the field read‑only and enforces append‑only mode to lock the document.

extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.title: Extract Text from PDF to UTF-8 File
extract-text-from-pdf-to-utf8-file.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, extracting all page text using TextAbsorber, and writing the result to a UTF‑8 encoded text file.

create-pdf-radio-button-group.title: Create PDF with Radio Button Group for Multiple Choice
create-pdf-radio-button-group.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF document containing a form with a radio button group representing a multiple‑choice question using Aspose.Pdf.

add-javascript-sum-numeric-pdf-form-fiel.title: Add JavaScript to Sum Numeric PDF Form Fields
add-javascript-sum-numeric-pdf-form-fiel.description: Demonstrates embedding Acrobat JavaScript in a PDF with Aspose.Pdf to calculate the total of two numeric form fields and display the result in a third field.

extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Extract XMP Metadata from PDF
extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, retrieve its embedded XMP metadata, and save it as an XML file.

create-multi-page-table-pdf.title: Create Multi‑Page Table in PDF with Aspose.Pdf
create-multi-page-table-pdf.description: Shows how to generate a PDF containing a table that automatically splits across pages, repeats the header row, and auto‑fits column widths using Aspose.Pdf.

add-line-separator-annotation-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Line Separator Annotation to PDF Page
add-line-separator-annotation-to-pdf-pag.description: Demonstrates how to insert a horizontal line annotation as a visual separator on a specific PDF page using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document.

set-pdf-page-rotation-90-degrees.title: Set PDF Page Rotation to 90 Degrees
set-pdf-page-rotation-90-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set each page's initial rotation to 90° for portrait display on landscape devices, and save the modified file.

create-pdf-with-date-picker.title: Create PDF with Date Picker Form Field
create-pdf-with-date-picker.description: Shows how to generate a PDF that contains a date picker form field, set its format, and apply basic visual styling using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-hyperlinks-from-pdf.title: Extract Hyperlinks from PDF and Save to Text File
extract-hyperlinks-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages and link annotations, extracts the target URLs, and writes them to a plain‑text file.

load-pdf-into-document.title: Load PDF File into Aspose.Pdf Document
load-pdf-into-document.description: Demonstrates how to verify a PDF file's existence, load it into an Aspose.Pdf Document object, and access basic document information such as page count.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v2.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, clear all annotations, and save the sanitized document.

sanitize-pdf-remove-embedded-scripts.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Embedded Scripts and Attachments
sanitize-pdf-remove-embedded-scripts.description: Demonstrates how to configure Aspose.Pdf's hidden data sanitizer to delete JavaScript actions and embedded files before sanitizing a PDF document.

sanitize-pdf-remove-metadata-private-inf.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Metadata and Private Information
sanitize-pdf-remove-metadata-private-inf.description: Demonstrates how to clear standard metadata and private data such as search indexes from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's optimization features, then save the sanitized document.

convert-pdf-pages-to-rasterized-images-h.title: Convert PDF Pages to Rasterized Images in HTML
convert-pdf-pages-to-rasterized-images-h.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.PDF and save it as HTML where each page is rasterized into external PNG images using a high‑resolution setting.

compress-pdf-images-and-export-jpeg-qual.title: Compress PDF Images and Export Pages as JPEG with Quality 80
compress-pdf-images-and-export-jpeg-qual.description: Shows how to compress embedded images in a PDF using JPEG quality 80 via OptimizationOptions, then render each page to a JPEG file with the same quality.

convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-no-compression.title: Convert PDF Pages to JPEG without Compression
convert-pdf-pages-to-jpeg-no-compression.description: Shows how to render each PDF page to a high‑resolution JPEG image using Aspose.Pdf while preserving original quality by disabling compression.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page, and save every page as an individual PNG image file.

selective-page-rasterization-hidden-data.title: Selective Page Rasterization with Hidden Data Sanitization
selective-page-rasterization-hidden-data.description: Demonstrates how to sanitize hidden data, optimize PDF resources, and rasterize specific pages by flattening transparency and replacing the original pages.

remove-annotations-and-attachments.title: Strip Annotations and Embedded Files from PDF
remove-annotations-and-attachments.description: Demonstrates how to flatten a PDF to remove annotations and form fields, delete embedded file attachments, and optimize the document by discarding unused objects and streams using Aspose.Pdf.

sanitize-pdfs-remove-metadata.title: Sanitize PDFs by Removing Metadata and Optimizing Resources
sanitize-pdfs-remove-metadata.description: The example loads each PDF from a folder, removes metadata, compliance information, flattens forms, optimizes resources, and saves the cleaned file to an output directory.

generate-pdf-crash-report.title: Generate PDF Crash Report on PdfException
generate-pdf-crash-report.description: Demonstrates catching a PdfException, configuring CrashReportOptions, and generating an HTML crash report file using Aspose.Pdf.

customize-crash-report-filename-message.title: Customize Crash Report Filename and Message in Aspose.Pdf
customize-crash-report-filename-message.description: Shows how to set a custom message and specify a custom file name for a crash report generated by Aspose.Pdf when an exception occurs.

generate-crash-report-with-custom-output.title: Generate Crash Report with Custom Output Directory
generate-crash-report-with-custom-output.description: Demonstrates how to configure a custom directory and filename for Aspose.Pdf crash reports using CrashReportOptions, then verifies that the report is created.

pdf-processing-with-crash-report.title: PDF Processing with Detailed Crash Report Generation
pdf-processing-with-crash-report.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, adding a blank page, saving it, and generating detailed crash reports for Aspose.Pdf exceptions and any unexpected errors using try‑catch blocks.

add-level-1-heading-to-pdf.title: Add Level 1 Heading to PDF using Tagged Content
add-level-1-heading-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF document, use the tagged content API to insert a Level 1 heading element, and save the file.

add-hierarchical-numbered-headings.title: Add Hierarchical Numbered Headings to PDF
add-hierarchical-numbered-headings.description: Shows how to apply decimal numbering to headings and create hierarchical numbering (chapters and sections) in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

structured-toc-with-headings.title: Create Structured Table of Contents with Headings
structured-toc-with-headings.description: Demonstrates adding Heading elements with auto‑sequencing and building a tagged PDF Table of Contents using Aspose.Pdf.

add-new-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.title: Add New Bookmark to PDF Outline
add-new-bookmark-to-pdf-outline.description: Demonstrates how to create an outline (bookmark) in an existing PDF, set its title, style, and destination, add it to the document's outline hierarchy, and save the updated file.

add-dynamic-heading-to-pdf.title: Add Dynamic Heading to PDF
add-dynamic-heading-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF template, create a heading with dynamic date and user information, position and style it, and save the updated document.

create-pdf-numbered-headings-sanitize.title: Create PDF with Numbered Headings and Sanitize Structure
create-pdf-numbered-headings-sanitize.description: The example creates a PDF containing numbered headings and body text, enables auto‑tagging to preserve the heading hierarchy, then sanitizes the document by removing metadata and PDF/UA compliance flags.

remove-hidden-data-rebuild-headings-pdf.title: Remove Hidden Data and Rebuild Headings in PDF
remove-hidden-data-rebuild-headings-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, strips hidden metadata and PDF/A/UA compliance flags, optimizes resources, reprocesses paragraphs to restore heading navigation, and saves the cleaned document.

batch-sanitize-pdfs.title: Batch Sanitize PDFs and Export Cleaned Versions
batch-sanitize-pdfs.description: Shows how to iterate over a folder of PDF files, remove metadata and compliance information, flatten content, optimize resources, and save sanitized copies to a separate directory using Aspose.Pdf.

sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Hidden Data
sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data.description: Shows a console app that loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, clears metadata, JavaScript, and embedded file annotations, then saves a sanitized copy.

check-hidden-annotations-in-pdf.title: Check for Hidden Annotations in PDF
check-hidden-annotations-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and inspect each page for annotations that have the Hidden flag set, returning a boolean result.

sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data-keep-met.title: Sanitize PDF by Removing Hidden Data While Preserving Metadata
sanitize-pdf-remove-hidden-data-keep-met.description: Demonstrates how to configure Aspose.Pdf to strip all hidden content from a PDF except its metadata, using optimization options and compliance flag removal.

rasterize-pdf-pages-to-png.title: Rasterize PDF Pages to PNG with Lossless Compression
rasterize-pdf-pages-to-png.description: Demonstrates how to convert each page of a PDF into a high‑resolution PNG image while applying lossless PNG compression using Aspose.Pdf's optimization options.

convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-tif.title: Convert PDF Pages to High-Resolution TIFF Images
convert-pdf-pages-to-high-resolution-tif.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set a custom DPI, and convert each page to a lossless TIFF file using TiffDevice.

convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images__v2.title: Convert PDF Pages to PNG Images and Verify Count
convert-pdf-pages-to-png-images__v2.description: Loads a PDF, renders each page to a PNG file using Aspose.Pdf, and asserts that the number of generated images matches the page count.

roman-numeral-headings-pdf.title: Create PDF with Roman Numeral Chapter Headings and Validate Sequence
roman-numeral-headings-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to generate a PDF with chapter headings formatted as uppercase Roman numerals, then reloads the file to verify that each heading follows the correct numeric order.

sanitize-pdf-add-heading.title: Sanitize PDF and Add Heading with Auto‑Tagging
sanitize-pdf-add-heading.description: Shows how to enable Aspose.Pdf auto‑tagging to sanitize a PDF, set language and title metadata, and create a top‑level heading and paragraph for improved navigation.

generate-pdf-crash-report__v2.title: Generate PDF Crash Report with Custom Message
generate-pdf-crash-report__v2.description: Demonstrates how to catch a PdfException, configure custom crash‑report options, and generate an HTML crash report using Aspose.Pdf.

generate-crash-report-to-network-share.title: Generate Crash Report to Network Share with Aspose.Pdf
generate-crash-report-to-network-share.description: Demonstrates configuring CrashReportOptions to write an Aspose.Pdf crash report to a UNC network share, with fallback handling and verification of the generated file.

log-pdf-sanitization-start-end-times.title: Log PDF Sanitization Start and End Times
log-pdf-sanitization-start-end-times.description: Demonstrates sanitizing a PDF with Aspose.Pdf while recording the operation's start time, end time, and duration to an audit log for auditing purposes.
